propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate planned onboarding projects for twenty-three suppliers and maintained the milestone schedule for each in the programme tracker.
propositions.rationale: The resume and tracker export document the planning work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate tracked integration milestones with the integration engineers and updated supplier status weekly.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the tracking work.

propositions.canonicalProposition: Average supplier onboarding time fell from 46 days to 29 days across the seventeen suppliers onboarded after the standard mapping templates, against a recorded baseline of 46 days.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the figures, the supplier count, the baseline and the tracker; the work sample and reference confirm them.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions for each completed onboarding are only partly documented in the completion notes.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the onboarding-time result as stated for the seventeen suppliers after the templates; do not extend it to the programme as a whole.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how hand-over points were recorded for each completed onboarding.
